tbesh_html:
1) to move, proceed, advance, move on, become old, be removed
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to move
1a2) to advance (in years), grow old and weak
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to move forward, proceed, move on
1b2) to remove
1b3) to transcribe

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe
strongs_1890.kjv_def: copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.
